     - Updated the condition that checks if a collection reference (`ref`) is null. The new condition checks if `ref` is null or if the collection exists in `legacyCollectionStates`.

The entry added to `CHANGES.txt` documents this fix, indicating that the changes made in the code are intended to resolve the identified issue. The changes in the code enhance the handling of collection states, ensuring that both new and legacy collections are appropriately managed without unnecessary refreshes, thereby improving the overall stability and performance of the ZkStateReader functionality.
